info.name: Fulcrum Public Accounting Code Material API

Get a material. DEPRECATED: use POST /v2/materials/get instead, which accepts the
material id in the request body. This endpoint fails for material ids that contain
'/' characters (e.g. "SS-301-CR 1/2 HD") because ASP.NET Core routing cannot match
URL-encoded forward slashes in path segments.
